title: Pertukaran Senyum di Antara Stasiun
theme: Menemukan kehangatan dan koneksi tak terduga di tengah rutinitas perjalanan pulang yang sunyi, membawa senyum di akhir hari.

cover.prompt: An interior view of an electric commuter train at late evening. A plush, empty seat gently positioned in the foreground, suggesting a moment of quiet repose. Through the rain-streaked window, a softly blurred, luminous city skyline of Jakarta glows in the distance. Soft, warm city lights shimmer and reflect on the just-wet asphalt below, creating a beautiful mirrored effect. The overall atmosphere evokes peaceful contemplation and a sense of profound weariness, yet also a subtle hope. The scene is composed with a rule of thirds approach.
cover.style: Cinematic photography, shallow depth of field, warm color grading

meta.plan_summary: A tired office worker, Risa, encounters a fellow commuter, Dani, on a late-night train. An accidental drop of a keyring sparks a brief but meaningful conversation about their shared urban struggles and dreams. This unexpected connection brings warmth and solace, transforming a mundane commute into a memorable moment of human interaction before they part ways with a genuine smile.
meta.target_emotion: warmth, comfort, hope, the joy of human connection, appreciation for small moments
